Measure the edge

Validation & Backtesting

Tracks projection coverage, model-vs-market disagreement and forward weekly snapshots. The first successful projection snapshot for a league/week is stored locally and never overwritten, preventing later results from silently contaminating the forecast.
Historical research backbone

Milestone 1 · Steps 0–9

A diagnostic-only research layer built around the frozen V8.2.2 control model. It measures data coverage, identity quality, position-specific opportunity stability, forward predictiveness and expanding-window validation before any signal is allowed to influence live rankings.
Guardrail: Milestone 1 cannot alter Draft, Waiver, Weekly, Trade or Team scores. Pass-play participation proxies are never presented as true routes run. Historical models use only information available before the predicted game.

Opportunity intelligence research

Milestone 2 · Steps 10–15

Decomposes fantasy production into team volume, player participation and opportunity share; estimates opportunity-based expected fantasy points; then tests regression, role changes, teammate competition and vacated opportunity before any signal can reach the live engine.
Guardrail: Milestone 2 is diagnostic-only. xFP excludes realized efficiency outcomes such as receptions, yards, touchdowns, tackles, sacks and interceptions. Vacated opportunity remains retrospective until a trustworthy pregame availability feed is joined.

Advanced positional & young-player research

Milestone 3 · Steps 16–18

Tests richer position-specific signal families, retrospective natural experiments and Y1/Y2 role acquisition. Advanced context is used only when it is historically available and lagged; public pass-play presence is never relabeled as routes and team pressure context is never relabeled as an individual pass rush.
Guardrail: Milestone 3 is diagnostic-only. A “validated candidate” is eligible for later integration review, not active in live scoring. Natural experiments are explicitly quasi-experimental and never presented as causal proof.

Model governance, market benchmark & blending

Milestone 4 · Steps 19–23

Consolidates the earlier evidence into a position-by-position governance registry, trains transparent raw-stat forward models, and prepares direct FIE versus Sleeper testing and position-specific blending without allowing any research result to alter live decisions.
Guardrail: Milestone 4 keeps every research feature, trained model and learned blend weight OFF. Direct Sleeper backtesting accepts only immutable pregame snapshots; old projection endpoints are never treated as historical snapshots after the fact.

Connects validated production evidence to Draft, Waivers and Weekly Start/Sit, then translates the common football projection into distinct Redraft, Dynasty, Best Ball and Chopped utilities.
Fail-closed activation: M5 never replaces a player decision merely because a research model exists. A compatible current-season decision snapshot must explicitly mark that player activation_eligible=true; otherwise the exact V8.2.2 live decision path remains in force.

League-derived replacement level

Replacement level is recalculated from the imported Sleeper league: team count, starting slots, FLEX / SUPER_FLEX / IDP_FLEX requirements, bench size and the league's actual positional ownership. It therefore changes automatically from league to league.
Replacement adjustment strength
Bench depth influence
Actual ownership influence
Two replacement currencies are shown. Model VOR preserves the V5-style 0–100 comparison for continuity. Projected VOR is the preferred V8.2 currency: league-scored projected season fantasy points minus the projected points of the league-specific replacement player at that position.

Automatic projection + market layer

Sleeper season projectionsAutomatic no-key baseline. The app reads Sleeper's projected raw stat line and re-scores it with the exact loaded league scoring settings instead of using generic PPR/half/standard points.
Engine projectionThe league-scored Sleeper baseline receives a deliberately bounded talent/opportunity adjustment from TFG percentile, PFF, current role and prior production. This adjustment remains experimental until historical backtesting calibrates it.
Sleeper market ADPThe app selects the closest available Sleeper draft-lobby ADP format, including dynasty, 2QB and IDP variants where appropriate. Undrafted/999 values are treated as missing.
Market edgePositive means the engine projection rank is earlier than Sleeper ADP. Example: projection rank 40, ADP 70 = +30 picks of apparent value.
Automatic projection source has not loaded yet.

Prediction engines · V7

Draft / seasonCurrent opportunity, league-scored prior production, PFF/TFG quality, depth-chart security, replacement value and team environment. Dynasty age/contract effects are deliberately lighter than in the acquisition model.
Waiver wireFree agents only by default. Role momentum, opportunity shock, teammate injuries, efficiency-vs-production buy-low signal, weekly outlook and dynasty Target Score.
Start / SitLeague-scored baseline PPG × projected role × opponent points allowed by position × team/game environment × live injury adjustment × weather/market context. Produces floor, mean, ceiling and a lineup recommendation.
UncertaintyRange widens for volatile positions, backups, injuries and low-evidence players. Risk preference can rank by floor, mean or ceiling.

Inputs still requiring an external source or user update

Official current injury/practice reportsnflverse currently has no post-2024 injury feed. V5 uses Sleeper injury fields. A stable official injury-report API/feed would improve status, practice participation and late-week projections.
Live bookmaker consensus / player propsnflverse schedules include lines when available. For fresher market data, paste a The Odds API key in the weekly controls. Player props would require an odds provider with prop coverage.
College production / athletic testingNeeded to materially improve rookie priors beyond draft capital + TFG + depth chart. Useful inputs: dominator/target share, YPRR, MTF/touch, breakout age and combine/pro-day testing.
Remaining TFG teamsBAL, BUF, DEN, DET, HOU, KC, LAR, PHI and SEA are still missing from the supplied workbook. V5 reweights rather than penalizing them.

V6 data & model health

V6 separates calculation from rendering. Filtering, searching and sorting no longer recompute the analytical model. TFG raw grades remain visible, while a position-relative percentile is used inside the model. Lineup selection uses exact maximum-weight assignment rather than a greedy slot fill.

Data status

SleeperLive league settings, roster ownership, depth metadata, player IDs, 24-hour trending adds, automatic season/weekly projections and draft-lobby ADP. Projection endpoints are not part of Sleeper's official public documentation, so V8.2 treats them as optional and falls back safely if unavailable.
nflverse PlayersPublic player identity table used for GSIS/PFR/OTC IDs plus draft year, round and pick.
OverTheCap via nflversePublic historical contract dataset. Active contract length, APY, guarantees and estimated expiry inform roster commitment and future openings.
nflverse prior-season StatsRegular + postseason player summary. Re-scored with the loaded league settings when recognizable stat fields are available.
PFR Snap Counts via nflversePrior-season game-level offense/defense/special-teams snap shares, used as a role-volume and production-reliability signal.
PFF 2025Regular season + postseason. Position-specific performance score is percentile-based and shrunk toward league average when the sample is small.
TFG 2026Current uploaded “Deep Dive Numbers” workbook, matched across the full player pool. Missing teams and missing players are not penalized.
Depth chartsY1/Y2: curated opportunity board, snapshot 19 Aug 2026. Everyone else: live Sleeper depth_chart_order / depth_chart_position estimate. Treat preseason roles as provisional until final/official depth charts.
Current TFG gaps: BAL, BUF, DEN, DET, HOU, KC, LAR, PHI, SEA. When a new TFG workbook is supplied, these can be incorporated without changing the app's ranking logic.
Fantasy Intelligence uses centralized league state, position/scoring contracts, exact lineup/replacement services and fail-closed research governance. Release identity is generated from one manifest. Diagnostic research signals are never treated as production evidence merely because they exist.
